description: This file defines enums, structs, and error handling mechanisms related to gateway connection authentication and response errors in a Swift project. It includes detailed error codes, recovery steps, and error descriptions for gateway connection processes.

classes.name: GatewayConnectAuthError
classes.description: Represents an error during gateway connection authentication, including relevant details and methods for error interpretation.

classes.name: GatewayResponseError
classes.description: Represents an error response from the gateway indicating a failed operation, includes error details and descriptions.

classes.name: GatewayDecodingError
classes.description: Represents an error encountered during decoding responses from the gateway, with context about method and message.

methods.name: GatewayConnectAuthError.init
methods.description: Initializes an auth error with message, detail code, retry capability, and optional recovery step.

methods.name: GatewayResponseError.init
methods.description: Initializes a gateway error with method, code, message, and additional details.

methods.name: GatewayDecodingError.init
methods.description: Initializes a decoding error with method and message context.
